name: loam
description: Work context for AI agents: connects your Loam knowledge base folder to Claude Desktop.
long_description: Loam keeps what your AI assistant needs to know about your work in a folder on your computer: your profile, your recurring processes, examples of good results, corrections and skills. This extension lets Claude Desktop read that folder and, when you ask, remember corrections and examples. Nothing leaves your computer: the extension makes no network requests and only touches the folder you choose. (Using Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Gemini CLI or another agent? See the install guide: they connect the same server with one command.)

tools.name: loam_overview
tools.description: Compact overview of the knowledge base: owner, processes with hours per year, skills.

tools.name: loam_get_process
tools.description: A process with its newest example path and its corrections.

tools.name: loam_search
tools.description: Ranked keyword search over the whole knowledge base.

tools.name: loam_read
tools.description: Read one text file inside the knowledge base folder.

tools.name: loam_list_skills
tools.description: List all skills with source, permissions and review state.

tools.name: loam_get_skill
tools.description: Read one skill. Imported skills come wrapped in a warning frame.

tools.name: loam_import_skill
tools.description: Add a skill from outside after a safety scan that blocks dangerous ones.

tools.name: loam_review_skill
tools.description: Get a skill inside a protective frame with a safety checklist to review it.

tools.name: loam_set_skill_review
tools.description: Record a review verdict on an imported skill (information only).

tools.name: loam_get_interview_script
tools.description: The onboarding interview script and your progress in it.

tools.name: loam_save_interview
tools.description: Save the interview results: profile, processes, glossary, entities.

tools.name: loam_upsert_note
tools.description: Write a markdown note when you ask; keeps the old version and shows the diff.

tools.name: loam_record_correction
tools.description: Remember a correction for a process so the next result is right.

tools.name: loam_add_example
tools.description: Save a finished result as an example of what good looks like.

tools.name: loam_generate_skill
tools.description: Rebuild a process skill from its description, examples and corrections.

tools.name: loam_log_run
tools.description: Count one run of a process.

tools.name: loam_lint
tools.description: Check the health of the knowledge base: size, repeats, gaps, cost.

knowledge_base_folder.title: Knowledge base folder
knowledge_base_folder.description: The folder you chose in the Loam app (the one that contains AGENTS.md). Loam only reads and writes inside it.
